Messages.Author: Mathieu
Messages.Body:
IIRC when a Clan-specific card text uses the Clan's name, it means
that vampire who changes Clans (from that card's required Clan to
another) can't "use" that card anymore (as in Sword of Judgement). Is
this right, and if it is, where and what is the precise ruling for this?

I'm trying to find out what happens to a Toreador who is "the second
Toreador" selected for use with a Toreador Grand Bal when (s)he plays
Clan Impersonation.

Thanx, Mathieu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mathieu <no.spam...@webmails.com> wrote:
> IIRC when a Clan-specific card text uses the Clan's name, it means
> that vampire who changes Clans (from that card's required Clan to
> another) can't "use" that card anymore (as in Sword of Judgement). Is
> this right, and if it is, where and what is the precise ruling for
> this?

It is correct. The ruling is: follow card text.

> I'm trying to find out what happens to a Toreador who is "the second
> Toreador" selected for use with a Toreador Grand Bal when (s)he plays
> Clan Impersonation.

He is unaffected (the TGB no longer prevents him from untapping
as normal, since he is no longer a Toreador).
